description: GateOnAI's guides and weekly notes (the blog): list or search them, or read one by slug - sections, the start of the text, the tools it names and the link to the full text.

limit.description: How many tools / items to return (default 10)

query.description: Words to search titles, summaries and tags

slug.description: Guide slug to read one guide

name: read_guides

links.description: gateonai.com URLs referenced in the result, in order of appearance

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result
